detailed_descriptions.en: You've been reincarnated as another world dark lord in this idle RPG game with the skill to be reborn again and again. Features ✨ What's in this game Play as an another world dark lord : Grow and absorb the mana around you. Devour everything you can to survive. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
You've been reincarnated as another world dark lord in this idle RPG game with the skill to be reborn again and again. Use experience from your past lives to choose paths for accumulating enough power to conquer everything.

Features

✨What's in this game

  • Play as an another world dark lord: Grow and absorb the mana around you. Devour everything you can to survive. Develop dark magic, create minions, or evolve into a powerful creature.

  • Short idle RPG: 5-10 hours of content with multiple story chapters, multiple endings, and secrets to discover.

  • Simple gameplay: Click to progress through the story and gain stats and resources automatically. All choices are displayed as branching paths for you to explore and easily see an overview of your entire journey.

  • Automation system: Command your shadow servants to work automatically or do it manually yourself. It's up to you.

☠️What's NOT in this game

  • The Prestige system doesn't make you stronger, but it makes subsequent playthroughs faster and unlocks various gameplay helpers.

  • No character control or walking and movement in the game.

  • No cut scenes or voice acting of any kind.
